title: 原创占位小道具（全目录 48 件） / original placeholder props (complete directory)
status: 原创占位，非最终美术；未指定许可；每件的尺度口径见其 dimension_check，48 件全部为 real（第一批 8 件按 README §12.4 重标）
conventions: geometry baked in metres, object transforms identity
closed shells only, triangulated, no n-gons
flat Principled base colours only: no textures, UVs or vertex colours
deterministic scripts: fixed formulas and fixed seeds
blender_version: mixed: 5.3.0 (39 props, batches 1-5) / 4.0.2 (9 props, batch 6); per prop: export_settings.blender
